import re
usertexts=[]
for m in msgs:
 if m.get('role')=='user':
  cont=m['content']
  txt='\n'.join(x.get('text','') for x in cont if x.get('type')=='text') if isinstance(cont,list) else str(cont)
  usertexts.append(txt)

def extract_demo(txt,n):
    res=[]
    for kind in ('input','output'):
        mt=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} {kind} \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\nDemo pair|\n\nSame instance)',txt,re.S)
        block=mt.group(1)
        rows=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in block.strip().splitlines() if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',line)]
        res.append(rows)
    return res
for i,txt in enumerate(usertexts[1:],1):
 print('message',i, txt[:45].replace('\n',' '))
for n in range(1,4):
 inp, expected=extract_demo(usertexts[n],n)
 predicted=mod.transform(inp)
 diffs=[(r,c,predicted[r][c],expected[r][c]) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if predicted[r][c]!=expected[r][c]]
 print(n, len(inp), len(inp[0]), 'diffs',len(diffs),diffs[:50])
